releaseNotes: Eternity Multi-Touch & AI Engine: Full kernel alignment with low-latency touch translation, cognitive hardware tuning, and adaptive gaming pace.
Autonomous Telemetry AI Architect: Deep device parameter telemetry governor dynamically diagnosing CPU, GPU, RAM, thermals, and FPS pacing with zero static shell recipes.
Professional eSports Sensi Panel: High-precision hardware touch calibration, custom response curves, and 1.00x pure linear pass-through without cheat presets.
Elevated Overlay HUD Toast: Dynamic top-level floating pill toast renders above all floating windows and games with distinct INFO (Cyan), SUCCESS (Green), NOTICE (Amber), and ERROR (Red) indicators.
Seamless VIP Experience: When VIP is active, all lock icons and VIP badges are completely removed across Neural Core, Sensi Panel, Macro Studio, and VPN Tunnel.
Centralized Home Touch Listener: Touch Listener activation is centralized in Home/Dashboard for VIP subscribers. Floating HUD provides direct Sensi Panel and Macro Studio cards.
100% English Global Default & Real-Time Dynamic Translation: Universal English default terminology across all components with full locale-aware translation.
Aesthetic Blurred Game Artwork: Game profiles display elegant, low-overhead GPU blurred backdrops matching each game's emblem.
Thermal & CPU Load Optimization: Throttled ADB background polling and zero-allocation Compose drawing to keep the device running cool.
Absolute Zero-Ghost Touch Protection: Hardware kernel BTN_TOUCH release detection guarantees instant pointer purge with zero phantom taps.
Ironclad Process Immunity Shield: Sentinel, Task Manager, and Autonomous AI Agent 100% protect Game Nuke, active games, and all OEM/3rd-party screen recorders.
Cross-Brand Android 11–16 Stability: Pre-flight injection capability tests ensure zero screen freeze across Samsung, Xiaomi/HyperOS, Oppo, Vivo, Asus ROG, Transsion, and Pixel.
